title: Euros top scorers since 1996
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals at European Championship finals since Euro 96. Goals at earlier tournaments do not count. Shoot-out penalties do not count.
period: Euro 96 to Euro 2024 (goals before 1996 not counted)

notes.Michel Platini: Michel Platini scored 9 at Euro 84, before 1996, so he does not count here.
notes.Zinedine Zidane: Zinedine Zidane is just outside with 5.
notes.Savo Milosevic: Savo Milosevic is just outside with 5.
notes.Milan Baros: Milan Baros is just outside with 5.
notes.Fernando Torres: Fernando Torres is just outside with 5.
notes.Mario Gomez: Mario Gomez is just outside with 5.
notes.Xherdan Shaqiri: Xherdan Shaqiri is just outside with 5.
notes.David Villa: David Villa scored 4, all at Euro 2008.

sources: https://compstats.uefa.com/v1/player-ranking?competitionId=3&phase=TOURNAMENT&stats=matches_appearance,goals&seasonYear=<year> (UEFA's own player stats, one call per tournament 1996 to 2024)
checks: UEFA's per-tournament goals for every player, 1996 to 2024, match goalscorers.csv goal for goal (717 goals each, own goals left out; the only differences are spellings). Ronaldo's 14 matches Wikipedia. None of the top 14 scored at a finals before 1996 (Shearer played Euro 92 but did not score), so taking off pre-1996 goals only removes Platini and others with no goals since 1996.
